errors.quote: *neighbors*, triples joined by side wires ($|S\cap T|=1,$ or distinct with even intersection), are orthogonal.
errors.problem: The two neighbor rules are not attributed to their networks; read as one relation the claim is false (in the bit network disjoint triples have $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=-1$; over $\mathbb F_2$ triples meeting in one point have dot product 1). The paper: bit neighbors have $|S\cap T|=1$, complex neighbors are distinct triples with even intersection.

errors.quote: $\Pi_V-\Pi_U$ is the identity on the residual and zero on its complement, so ranks equal dimension changes
errors.problem: On a decreasing edge (the central $3\to4$ edges) $\Pi_V-\Pi_U$ is minus the identity on the residual. The paper notes that reversing the edge negates the matrix without changing its rank, so the rank count is unaffected.
